_comment: FORMAT EXAMPLE ONLY - not a working profile. Real profiles are built with make_template.py from your own footage. Copy to profiles/<game>/profile.json once templates exist.
name: example_game
_other_genres: Same mechanism, different data: a fighting game uses 'while': 'round_health_bars' with 'ends_with': {'ko': {...}}; a horror game can use a boss bar or a death screen; an open-world game can use mission-passed / wasted banners as plain markers. Games with no profile still get universal analysis.
